faction.feydom.feydom.description:
Feydom
Alignment: Evil
Native Terrain: Wasteland
Location: Eastern Mysterious Continent
The Yao clan is a mysterious race from the East. Originally ordinary birds and beasts, they gained sentience by absorbing solar and lunar essence, embarking on the path of cultivation. They spontaneously gathered, occupying mountains as kings, and under the leadership of powerful Yao Kings, compete for cultivation resources.
faction.feydom.feydom.name: Feydom
hero.feydom.feydomHero01_feylordBull.bio: Originally a white giant bull who cultivated into a spirit. Skilled in strategy and warfare, with immense strength, honored as the Great Strength King. Currently resides with Princess Jade Face in the Cloudy Cave of Thunderclap Mountain, with his original wife Iron Fan Princess bearing him a son named Red Boy.
hero.feydom.feydomHero01_feylordBull.spe: Law of Heaven, Manifestation of Earth
hero.feydom.feydomHero02_blueLion.biogra: Originally the mount of Manjushri Bodhisattva, its massive jaws can swallow 100,000 heavenly soldiers. After descending to the mortal world, it occupies Lion Camel Ridge and is sworn brothers with the Six-Tusked White Elephant and Golden-Winged Great Peng.
hero.feydom.feydomHero02_blueLion.name: Blue Lion King
hero.feydom.feydomHero02_blueLion.specia: Feasters and Devourers Speed +1; Feasters and Devourers Hit Points +1 per hero level.
hero.feydom.feydomHero03_whiteElephant.b: Originally the mount of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva. After descending, occupies Lion Camel Ridge, sworn brothers with Blue Lion King and Golden-Winged Great Peng.
hero.feydom.feydomHero03_whiteElephant.s: Greatly enhances the effect of Stone Skin spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero04_goldenRoc.biogr: One of the Phoenix descendants; its sister Peacock is revered as the Buddha's mother. The Golden-Winged Great Peng fell to the mortal realm, occupying Lion Camel Country, later going to Lion Camel Ridge to become sworn brothers with Blue Lion King and Six-Tusked White Elephant.
hero.feydom.feydomHero04_goldenRoc.name: Golden-Winged Great Peng
hero.feydom.feydomHero04_goldenRoc.speci: Logistics skill receives +5% bonus per level.
hero.feydom.feydomHero05_greatApe.biogra: An enlightened old monkey from Flower-Fruit Mountain, said to grasp sun and moon, contract mountains, discern fortune and misfortune, manipulate heaven and earth. Multiple times guided the Monkey King, encouraging him to seek a master, obtain divine weapons; deeply trusted by Monkey King. When its lifespan neared end, Monkey King stormed the underworld to destroy the Book of Life and Death to extend its life.
hero.feydom.feydomHero05_greatApe.name: Long-Armed Ape Monkey
hero.feydom.feydomHero05_greatApe.specia: Snow Apes and Bee-Controlling Apes Speed +1, Damage +3.
hero.feydom.feydomHero06_blueBull.biogra: Originally the mount of Taishang Laojun. Seeing the cowherd boy fall asleep after mistakenly eating immortal pills, it took family treasures and descended to become a demon, calling itself the One-Horned Rhinoceros King.
hero.feydom.feydomHero06_blueBull.name: One-Horned Rhinoceros King
hero.feydom.feydomHero06_blueBull.specia: Greatly enhances the effect of Ice Ring spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero07_saintLion.biogr: Originally a bear spirit cultivated in Black Wind Cave of Black Wind Mountain, alias Bear Pi Monster, Black Wind Monster. On good terms with Elder Golden Pool of Guanyin Temple, often lectures on Taoism and Zen.
hero.feydom.feydomHero07_saintLion.name: Black Bear Spirit
hero.feydom.feydomHero07_saintLion.speci: Provides +350 gold daily to the kingdom.
hero.feydom.feydomHero08_sixears.biograp: Six-Eared Macaque, one of the 'Four Mischievous Monkeys'. Abilities rival Sun Wukong: good at listening, discerning principles, knowing past and future, understands all things. Masters the same 72 transformations, somersault cloud, etc. Weapon 'Wish-Fulfilling Iron Staff' identical to Ruyi Jingu Bang.
hero.feydom.feydomHero08_sixears.name: Six-Eared Macaque
hero.feydom.feydomHero08_sixears.special: Learning skill receives +5% bonus per level.
hero.feydom.feydomHero09_gold.biography: Golden Horn King, originally disciple of Taishang Laojun, guarding the alchemy furnace. Descended at request of Guanyin Bodhisattva three times to test Tang Seng's resolve and seize his treasures.
hero.feydom.feydomHero09_gold.name: Golden Horn King
Reduces enemy morale by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom.feydomHero10_silver.biograph: Originally Silver Spirit Boy under Taishang Laojun, descended and became Silver Horn King, occupying Lotus Flower Cave with Golden Horn King.
hero.feydom.feydomHero10_silver.name: Silver Horn King
hero.feydom.feydomHero10_silver.specialt: Reduces enemy Luck by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom.feydomHero11_yellowMouse.bio: Originally a weasel at the foot of Lingshan, stole lamp oil causing the Buddha hall to go dark, fled in fear of guardian Vajra, became mountain king in mortal realm.
hero.feydom.feydomHero11_yellowMouse.spe: Greatly enhances the effect of Armageddon spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero12_leopard.biograp: Shen Gongbao, disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun, later rebelled from Chanism. Cunning, skilled in persuasion, incited Jieism fellows to aid King Zhou against Zhou. Violated oath, body filled North Sea eye, finally sealed as Water Division General of East Sea.
hero.feydom.feydomHero12_leopard.name: Shen Gongbao
hero.feydom.feydomHero12_leopard.special: Greatly enhances the effect of Lightning Bolt spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero51_yellowBrow.biog: Originally the chime attendant of Donglai Buddha, stole Buddha's treasures and descended privately, built Mini Thunderclap Temple imitating Western Great Thunderclap Temple, impersonating Tathagata Buddha.
hero.feydom.feydomHero51_yellowBrow.name: Yellow Brow King
hero.feydom.feydomHero51_yellowBrow.spec: Base army Attack +1% per hero level; artifact Attack bonus +1% extra per level.
hero.feydom.feydomHero52_redKid.biograph: Son of Bull Demon King and Iron Fan Princess, titled Holy Infant Great King. Childlike appearance but high cultivation, wields Samadhi True Fire, fought Monkey King multiple times without defeat.
hero.feydom.feydomHero52_redKid.name: Red Boy
hero.feydom.feydomHero53_rakshasi.biogra: Wife of Bull Demon King, resides in Banana Cave of Emerald Cloud Mountain, bore son Red Boy. Conflicted with Monkey King but repented in time, later cultivated in seclusion to achieve enlightenment.
hero.feydom.feydomHero53_rakshasi.name: Iron Fan Princess
hero.feydom.feydomHero53_rakshasi.specia: Greatly enhances the effect of Haste spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero54_ladyFox.biograp: Favorite consort of King Zhou of Shang, Di Xin. With national beauty and talents, deeply favored by Zhou. Dispatched by Nüwa to bring chaos to Shang Dynasty.
hero.feydom.feydomHero54_ladyFox.name: Su Daji
hero.feydom.feydomHero54_ladyFox.special: Greatly enhances the effect of Hypnotize spell.
hero.feydom.feydomHero55_ladyWhiteBone.b: Originally mountain wild bones, gathered earthly spiritual energy, absorbed sun and moon essence, gained sentience, can shapeshift into human form.
hero.feydom.feydomHero55_ladyWhiteBone.s: Increases this hero's map movement speed by 5.
hero.feydom.feydomHero56_ladySpider.biog: One of the female demons in Pan Silk Cave, originally a spider in the cave, cultivated to shapeshift into human form, can spit spider silk from navel.
hero.feydom.feydomHero56_ladySpider.name: Spider Spirit
hero.feydom.feydomHero56_ladySpider.spec: Reduces all enemy unit speeds by 1 in combat.
hero.feydom.feydomHero57_ladyEarthFlow.b: Originally a golden-nosed white-furred rat from Lingshan, caught by Li Jing and Nezha after stealing incense flowers and treasures. Tathagata mercifully spared its life and released it back to the wilds.
hero.feydom.feydomHero57_ladyEarthFlow.s: Offense skill receives +5% bonus per level.
hero.feydom.feydomHero58_jadeRabbit.biog: Originally the jade rabbit pounding medicine in the Moon Palace of Guanghan. After receiving a slap from Fairy Chang'e, harbored grudge. When Chang'e reincarnated as Tianzhu Princess, descended as demon to seek revenge.
hero.feydom.feydomHero58_jadeRabbit.name: Jade Rabbit Spirit
hero.feydom.feydomHero58_jadeRabbit.spec: Pathfinding skill receives +5% bonus per level.
